title: Pre-Orders & Back-Orders — Work Charge Kept on a Made-to-Order Reservation Cancelled in Production
content:
The work charge on a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Made-to-Order Reservation cancelled in production is calculated as follows.

**Calculation.** The work charge is the reserved unit price times the units, multiplied by the work share for the production stage reached. The work share is the standard work share of 50 percent. The production stage is the number of calendar days from the production start date to an end date. The end date is the date of the customer's most recent cancellation request on the reservation when that request is still pending confirmation, or today when no request is pending. The start day is not counted and the end day is. The work charge never exceeds the deposit held on the reservation, and it is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end. The refund of the rest is the deposit held less the work charge. Once any delay notice has been sent for the reservation, no work charge is kept and the whole deposit is refunded.

**Where each input comes from**

| Input | Record |
|---|---|
| Reserved unit price and units | The reservation record (the reserved unit price as it currently stands) |
| Deposit held | The reservation's history: the total of its deposit entries, with the deposit charged counted in and anything already refunded, kept or applied counted out |
| Delay notices | The reservation's history: any delay notice entry at all |
| Production start date | The reservation record |
| Most recent cancellation request, its date and its status | The reservation's request records |

**How the figure is put together.** The work charge is worked out as one product of the reserved price (unit price times units) and the work share, with no rounding along the way. The cap at the deposit held and the rounding to the cent apply to that product, as the last steps of the calculation. The amount kept is the lower of that product and the deposit held, rounded half up to the cent. The refund is the deposit held less the amount kept.

**Worked examples (hypothetical reservations of one pair, no delay notice)**

| Reserved unit price | Deposit held | Price times 50 percent | Work charge kept | Refund of the rest |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $360.00 | $180.00 | $180.00 | $180.00 | $0.00 |
| $90.00 | $50.00 | $45.00 | $45.00 | $5.00 |
| $425.50 | $212.75 | $212.75 | $212.75 | $0.00 |

With a delay notice on the history, any of these reservations keeps $0.00, and the whole deposit held is refunded.

**Production stage, worked (hypothetical dates).** Production started on 2 March, and the customer's most recent cancellation request, dated 20 March, is still pending confirmation. The production stage is 18 days: 2 March is not counted and 20 March is. If no request were pending, the stage would run to today instead.
